auto_translation: The King who was hung on the cross is the King of all creation, ruling over heaven and earth, life and death.
final_translation: The King who was hung on the cross is the King of all creation, ruling over heaven and earth, life and death.

stt_text: 그러므로 그분의 사랑은 마음은 있지만 아무것도 할 수 없는 약한 사랑이 아닙니다.
auto_translation: Therefore, His love is not a weak love that has only a heart for us but can do nothing.
final_translation: Therefore, His love is not a weak love that has only a heart for us but can do nothing.

stt_text: 죄와 죽음과 모든 권세를 이기고, 자기 백성을 끝까지 붙드시며 데리고 가시는 전능한 왕의 사랑입니다.
auto_translation: It is the love of the almighty King, who has overcome sin, death, and every power, and who holds on to His people to the end and leads them on.
final_translation: It is the love of the almighty King, who has overcome sin, death, and every power, and who holds on to His people to the end and leads them on.

stt_text: 나의 주인이 나를 위해 성문 밖으로 나가신 왕이기 때문입니다.
auto_translation: Because my Lord is the King who went out beyond the city gate for me.
final_translation: Because my Lord is the King who went out beyond the city gate for me.

stt_text: 성도 여러분, 내가 주인이 아니라는 사실이 왜 복음입니까?
auto_translation: Beloved congregation, why is it the gospel that I am not the master?
final_translation: Beloved congregation, why is it the gospel that I am not the master?

stt_text: 우리가 왕의 통치에 합당한 백성이 아니었기 때문에 왕께서 우리의 심판을 담당하셨습니다.
auto_translation: Because we were not a people worthy of the King’s rule, the King took upon Himself our judgment.
final_translation: Because we were not a people worthy of the King’s rule, the King took upon Himself our judgment.

stt_text: 그러므로 우리의 소망은 내가 내 삶을 얼마나 잘 붙들고 있는가에 달려 있지 않습니다.
auto_translation: Therefore, our hope does not depend on how well I am holding on to my life.
final_translation: Therefore, our hope does not depend on how well I am holding on to my life.

stt_text: 그리고 부활하신 왕께서 우리를 붙드시고, 자신의 임재와 통치 안으로 끝까지 데리고 들어가십니다.
auto_translation:
And the risen King holds us fast 
and leads us all the way into His presence and reign.
final_translation:
And the risen King holds us fast 
and leads us all the way into His presence and reign.

stt_text: 우리의 소망은 세상과 내 삶을 다스리시며, 나를 위해 자신을 내어 주신 영광나를 위해 자신을 내어 주신 영광의 왕께 있습니다.
auto_translation: Our hope is in the King of glory, who rules over the world and my life, and who gave himself for me.
final_translation: Our hope is in the King of glory, who rules over the world and my life, and who gave himself for me.

stt_text: 영광의 왕께서 들어오십니다.
auto_translation: The King of glory is coming in.
final_translation: The King of glory is coming in.

stt_text: 결론 성도 여러분, 오늘 시편은 처음부터 마지막까지 한 분을 바라보게 합니다.
auto_translation: In conclusion, brothers and sisters, today’s psalm leads us to look to one person from beginning to end.
final_translation: In conclusion, brothers and sisters, today’s psalm leads us to look to one person from beginning to end.

stt_text: 그리고 그 왕께서 우리를 구원하여 다스리시고, 끝까지 데리고 들어가십니다.
auto_translation: And that King will reign over us salvation, and lead us in until the end.
final_translation: And that King will reign over us salvation, and lead us in until the end.

stt_text: 세상은 여호와의 것입니다.
auto_translation: The world is the LORD's.
final_translation: The world is the LORD's.

stt_text: 우리의 삶도, 우리의 가정도, 우리가 염려하는 미래도 처음부터 그분의 것입니다.
auto_translation: Our lives, our families, and even the future we worry about all belong to Him from the beginning.
final_translation: Our lives, our families, and even the future we worry about all belong to Him from the beginning.

stt_text: 우리가 그분께 올라갈 수 없었기 때문에 왕께서 먼저 내려오셨습니다.
auto_translation: Because we could not go up to Him, the King came down first.
final_translation: Because we could not go up to Him, the King came down first.

stt_text: 하지만 우리는 그 왕의 통치에 합당하지 않았습니다.
auto_translation: But we were not worthy of that King’s rule.
final_translation: But we were not worthy of that King’s rule.

stt_text: 내가 손을 놓으면 모든 것이 무너질 것처럼 살았습니다.
auto_translation: I have lived as if everything would fall apart if I let go.
final_translation: I have lived as if everything would fall apart if I let go.

stt_text: 하나님의 말씀보다 내 생각을 더 무겁게 여겼고, 하나님을 신뢰하기보다 내가 내 인생의 주인이 되어 모든 것을 붙들려고 했습니다.
auto_translation: I valued my own thoughts more heavily than God’s word, and instead of trusting God, I tried to be the master of my own life and hold on to everything.
final_translation: I valued my own thoughts more heavily than God’s word, and instead of trusting God, I tried to be the master of my own life and hold on to everything.

stt_text: 그리고 그 왕은 우리의 주일만이 아니라 손과 마음과 영혼과 입술, 곧 우리의 삶 전체를 다스리십니다.
auto_translation: And that King rules not only our Sundays, but our hands, our hearts, our souls, our lips—indeed, our whole lives.
final_translation: And that King rules not only our Sundays, but our hands, our hearts, our souls, our lips—indeed, our whole lives.

stt_text: 그런 우리에게 영광의 왕께서 오셨습니다.
auto_translation: To us like that, the King of glory has come.
final_translation: To us like that, the King of glory has come.

stt_text: 우리가 그분께 올라갈 수 없었기 때문에 왕께서 우리에게 내려오셨습니다.
auto_translation: Because we could not go up to Him, the King came down to us.
final_translation: Because we could not go up to Him, the King came down to us.

stt_text: 성문 안으로 들어가실 자격이 있는 왕이 우리를 데리고 들어가기 위해 성문 밖으로 나가셨습니다.
auto_translation: The King who is worthy to enter through the gate went out beyond the gate to bring us in.
final_translation: The King who is worthy to enter through the gate went out beyond the gate to bring us in.

stt_text: 그곳에서 우리의 죄와 심판을 담당하시고, 부활하셔서 자기 백성을 하나님 앞으로 이끄셨습니다.
auto_translation: There He bore our sin and judgment, and by rising again, He led His people before God.
final_translation: There He bore our sin and judgment, and by rising again, He led His people before God.

stt_text: 성도 여러분, 내가 주인이 아니라는 사실이 왜 복음입니까?
auto_translation: Believers, why is it the gospel that I am not the master?
final_translation: Believers, why is it the gospel that I am not the master?

stt_text: 나의 주인이 나를 위해 성문 밖으로 나가신 왕이기 때문입니다.
auto_translation: Because my Master is the King who went out beyond the city gate for me.
final_translation: Because my Master is the King who went out beyond the city gate for me.

stt_text: 우리가 믿는 왕은 멀리서 명령만 내리는 왕이 아닙니다.
auto_translation: The King we believe in is not a king who only gives orders from far away.
final_translation: The King we believe in is not a king who only gives orders from far away.

stt_text: 자기 영광을 위해 백성을 희생하는 왕이 아니라, 자기 백성을 살리기 위해 자신을 내어 주신 왕이십니다.
auto_translation: He is not a king who sacrifices his people for his own glory, but a king who gave himself for the sake of saving his people.
final_translation: He is not a king who sacrifices his people for his own glory, but a king who gave himself for the sake of saving his people.

stt_text: 그러므로 “내 삶은 하나님의 것입니다”라는 말은 우리를 위협하는 말이 아닙니다.
auto_translation: Therefore, the statement, “My life belongs to God,” is not a threatening statement to us.
final_translation: Therefore, the statement, “My life belongs to God,” is not a threatening statement to us.

stt_text: 그러므로 이제 내가 모든 것을 책임져야 한다는 주인의 짐을 내려놓으십시오.
auto_translation: Therefore, now please lay down the burden of being the one who must take responsibility for everything.
final_translation: Therefore, now please lay down the burden of being the one who must take responsibility for everything.

stt_text: 우리를 소유하신 분이 우리를 위해 자신을 내어 주신 영광의 왕이시기 때문입니다.
auto_translation: Because the King of glory, who owns us, gave Himself for us.
final_translation: Because the King of glory, who owns us, gave Himself for us.

stt_text: 내 계획이 흔들리고, 가족의 미래가 내 뜻대로 되지 않고, 앞으로의 길이 보이지 않을 때에도 두려움에 눌리지 마십시오.
auto_translation: Even when my plans are shaken, when my family’s future does not go as I want, and when the road ahead is not clear, do not be overwhelmed by fear.
final_translation: Even when my plans are shaken, when my family’s future does not go as I want, and when the road ahead is not clear, do not be overwhelmed by fear.

stt_text: 나는 세상의 주인이 아니기 때문에 모든 것을 통제할 수 없습니다.
auto_translation: I am not the master of the world, so I cannot control everything.
final_translation: I am not the master of the world, so I cannot control everything.

stt_text: 우리가 세상을 붙들고 있는 것이 아니라, 영광의 왕께서 우리와 세상을 붙들고 계십니다.
auto_translation: We are not the ones holding on to the world; it is the King of glory who is holding us and the world.
final_translation: We are not the ones holding on to the world; it is the King of glory who is holding us and the world.

stt_text: 그러나 세상에 주인이 없는 것은 아닙니다.
auto_translation: But the world is not without a master.
final_translation: But the world is not without a master.

stt_text: 내가 잠든 밤에도 왕께서는 세상을 다스리십니다.
auto_translation: Even while I sleep at night, the King rules over the world.
final_translation: Even while I sleep at night, the King rules over the world.

stt_text: 그리고 그 손은 우리를 위해 십자가에 못 박히신 손입니다.
auto_translation: And that hand is the hand that was nailed to the cross for us.
final_translation: And that hand is the hand that was nailed to the cross for us.

stt_text: 내가 길을 알지 못할 때에도 왕께서는 길을 잃지 않으십니다.
auto_translation: Even when I do not know the way, the King does not lose His way.
final_translation: Even when I do not know the way, the King does not lose His way.

stt_text: 그러니 이제 그 왕의 통치 안에서 안심하십시오.
auto_translation: So now, rest assured under the rule of that King.
final_translation: So now, rest assured under the rule of that King.

stt_text: 이번 한 주를 살아가며 마음이 흔들릴 때마다 이 말씀을 기억하십시오.
auto_translation: As you live through this week, whenever your heart is shaken, remember these words.
final_translation: As you live through this week, whenever your heart is shaken, remember these words.

stt_text: 그러므로 아직 맡기지 못한 염려와 내려놓지 못한 계획과 미래를 왕의 손에 맡겨 드립시다.
auto_translation: Therefore, let us entrust the worries we have not yet given over, and the plans and future we have not yet laid down, into the King’s hands.
final_translation: Therefore, let us entrust the worries we have not yet given over, and the plans and future we have not yet laid down, into the King’s hands.

stt_text: “영광의 왕이 들어가시리로다.”
auto_translation: Who is this King of glory?
final_translation: Who is this King of glory?

stt_text: 그 영광의 왕이 오늘도 우리를 다스리고 붙드시며, 자기 백성을 끝까지 데리고 가십니다.
auto_translation: The King of glory rules over us today as well, holds us fast, and leads His people all the way to the end.
final_translation: The King of glory rules over us today as well, holds us fast, and leads His people all the way to the end.
